report.summary: Patient P-D011 (Priyanka Sood, age 34, commercial high-deductible plan, deductible not met, no transport benefit) needs help with medication costs and transportation. Key finding: semaglutide pen 0.5 mg weekly has a $250/month copay (tier 4) with a 14-day refill gap — this is the primary med-cost concern; metformin ER is only $4/month with no gap. Social screener (10/26/2026) indicates no transportation difficulty reported, but the patient has no plan transport benefit and lives in a tract where 47.6% of households have no vehicle (transit stops are plentiful). Recent appointments are at "Clinic" with no facility location on file, so I could not run a transit feasibility check for appt:1 (2026-09-08 16:30) or appt:2 (2026-10-26 16:30).

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay assistance for current clinic patients; contact the clinic to apply.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Same-day copay help; clinic sends patient MRN and medication list to the pre-approval endpoint. Best fit for the $250/month semaglutide copay.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer assistance programs (useful given commercial high-deductible plan).

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Patient is not 60+ (ineligible for Senior Shuttle) and not on Medicaid (ineligible for Medicaid Ride Line).

options.name: CTA/Pace fixed-route transit
options.how_to_access: Home tract has 88 transit stops within 800m and 87 with early-morning service; no-vehicle household share is 47.6%. Could not verify trip feasibility because appointment facility location is not on file — confirm clinic address, then run a transit check.
